d:
The Trail Blazers defeated the Jazz, 112-90 tonight in Utah. Deni Avdija finished with a team-high 24 points along with 5 rebounds and 2 assists for the Trail Blazers, while Damian Lillard tallied 22 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists in the game. Darryn Peterson recorded 16 points, 4 rebounds and 4 assists. The Trail Blazers improve their record to 4-1 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 1-5 for the season.
